args.query: Taylor expansion multivariate polynomial coefficients Hasse derivatives

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_natDegree_eq_C
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv f.natDegree) f = Polynomial.C f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn.fderivWithin
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
  {f : E → F} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {s : Set E},
  HasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn n f p s →
    ∀ (m : ℕ), ↑m < n → ∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => p x m) (p x m.succ).curryLeft s x
